source.name: spglib
source.note: international and Schoenflies labels, Hall symbols, and Seitz operations generated from the spglib database; every Hall setting is stored, with the round-trip-verified setting marked primary.

conventions.seitz: x' = R x + t in fractional coordinates of the conventional cell, translations modulo the lattice
conventions.primary: lowest Hall number whose operations round-trip: three generic positions on a conventional lattice identified by spglib as the same ITA number
conventions.generators: deterministic greedy reduction whose closure reproduces the full operation set of each Hall setting
conventions.symmorphic: fixed-point criterion modulo the cell lattice: an origin shift makes every non-identity rotation pure
